scope: offline environment acceptance; no Phase-0 study
network: cached archives only; fail before installation on missing or mismatched cache; R repos=NULL and pip --no-index --require-hashes
exact_comparisons: all R and Python package names/versions
R source/binary and Python wheel URL/size/SHA-256 identities
R sessionInfo and sf external libraries
four semantic mesh hashes and all projector metrics
path_equivalence: replace each environment root with ENVIRONMENT_ROOT; retain the shared base-R path unchanged

functional_comparisons.process_tree: live child detected, at least two processes and positive RSS; RSS/PIDs are not deterministic semantic outputs
functional_comparisons.sparse_roundtrip: exact dimensions, pointers, indices and values
functional_comparisons.index_corruptions: both rejected in both fresh sessions

immutability: accepted mesh environment/shared R runtime/SCT library: full path-size-SHA256 inventories; global/user libraries: path-size-mtime_ns-ctime_ns inventories plus installer isolation; additions/removals or recorded changes fail
retention: retain restoration root and external inventory evidence; no automatic cleanup
limitations: no real-section mesh or FEM accuracy/resource certification
